theorem exists_deletedProduct_le_strict (a : ι → ℕ) {n D : ℕ}

    (hcut : n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) < (D + 1) ^ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ i : ι, deletedProduct a i ≤ D := by
  have hcpos : 0 < Fintype.card ι := by omega
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).Nonempty :=
    Finset.card_pos.mp (by simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using hcpos)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ a hne
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hbound : deletedProduct a i ≤ a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by
    simpa only [deletedProduct, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, Finset.card_univ] using
      (Finset.prod_le_pow_card ((Finset.univ : Finset ι).erase i) a (a i)
        (fun j _hj => hmax j (Finset.mem_univ j)))
  have hpower : deletedProduct a i ^ Fintype.card ι ≤ n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by
    calc
      deletedProduct a i ^ Fintype.card ι =
          deletedProduct a i ^ ((Fintype.card ι - 1) + 1) := by congr 1; omega
      _ = deletedProduct a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * deletedProduct a i := pow_succ _ _
      _ ≤ deletedProduct a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * a i ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hbound
      _ = (deletedProduct a i * a i) ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
      _ = n ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) := by rw [deletedProduct_mul, hprod]
  by_contra h
  have hsucc : D + 1 ≤ deletedProduct a i := by omega
  have hmono : (D + 1) ^ Fintype.card ι ≤ deletedProduct a i ^ Fintype.card ι :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.zero_le _) hsucc _
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmono.trans hpower)) hcut

    pow_lt_pow_left₀ (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _) hR0 (by omega : K ≠ 0)
  rw [realDeletionRadius_pow hK (by linarith : 0 ≤ Z)] at hlt

    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg B) hBZ _

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_natCast (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n := by simpa using rpow_intCast x n

lemma rpow_mul_natCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n := by
  rw [rpow_mul hx, rpow_natCast]

theorem one_le_rpow {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 1 ≤ x ^ z := by
  rw [← one_rpow z]
  gcongr

theorem rpow_le_self_of_one_le (h₁ : 1 ≤ x) (h₂ : y ≤ 1) : x ^ y ≤ x := by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h₁ h₂

theorem floor_le (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌊a⌋₊ : R) ≤ a :=
  (le_floor_iff ha).1 le_rfl

theorem floor_eq_iff (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ⌊a⌋₊ = n ↔ ↑n ≤ a ∧ a < ↑n + 1 := by
  rw [← le_floor_iff ha, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← floor_lt ha, Nat.lt_add_one_iff,
    le_antisymm_iff, and_comm]

theorem lt_of_floor_lt (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < n) : a < n :=
  lt_of_not_ge fun h' => (le_floor h').not_gt h

theorem lt_one_of_floor_lt_one (h : ⌊a⌋₊ < 1) : a < 1 := mod_cast lt_of_floor_lt h

theorem lt_succ_floor (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊.succ :=
  lt_of_floor_lt <| Nat.lt_succ_self _

@[bound]
theorem lt_floor_add_one (a : R) : a < ⌊a⌋₊ + 1 := by simpa using lt_succ_floor a

@[bound]
theorem le_ceil (a : R) : a ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ :=
  ceil_le.1 le_rfl

theorem ceil_lt_add_one (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌈a⌉₊ : R) < a + 1 :=
  lt_ceil.1 <| (Nat.lt_succ_self _).trans_le (ceil_add_one ha).ge

@[mono, gcongr, bound]
theorem pow_le_pow_left₀ [PosMulMono M₀] [MulPosMono M₀]
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : ∀ n, a ^ n ≤ b ^ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simpa using hab
  | n + 2 => by simpa only [pow_succ']
      using mul_le_mul hab (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab _) (pow_succ_nonneg ha _) (ha.trans hab)

@[gcongr, bound]
lemma pow_lt_pow_left₀ [MulPosMono M₀] (hab : a < b)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n
  | 1, _ => by simpa using hab
  | n + 2, _ => by
    simpa only [pow_succ] using mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hab.le _) hab ha (pow_succ_pos (ha.trans_lt hab) _)
lemma div_mul_cancel₀ (a : G₀) (h : b ≠ 0) : a / b * b = a := by simp [h]

theorem log_le_log_iff (h : 0 < x) (h₁ : 0 < y) : log x ≤ log y ↔ x ≤ y := by
  rw [← exp_le_exp, exp_log h, exp_log h₁]

@[gcongr, bound]
lemma log_le_log (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : log x ≤ log y :=
  (log_le_log_iff hx (hx.trans_le hxy)).2 hxy

@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x :=
  (log_nonneg_iff (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)).2 hx

theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log x) ^ k := by
  have heq : reciprocalSum ⌊x⌋₊ = (harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have hI : Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ = Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊ := by
      ext; simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_Icc]; omega
    simp [reciprocalSum, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, hI]
  exact (sum_reciprocalTau_le k ⌊x⌋₊).trans
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _)
      (heq ▸ harmonic_floor_le_one_add_log x hx) _)

theorem sum_fouvryTau_le (k N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (fouvryTau (k + 1) n : ℝ)) ≤
      N * (1 + Real.log N) ^ k := by
  refine (sum_fouvryTau_le_harmonic k N).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (reciprocalSum_nonneg _) (reciprocalSum_le_log _) _) (by positivity)

/-- Real-endpoint form, uniform in `x`, with the order kept explicit. -/
theorem sum_fouvryTau_le_real {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have hfloor : 1 ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by simpa using hx)
  have hlog : 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊x⌋₊ by omega))
      (Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))
    linarith
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ by exact_mod_cast hfloor)
    linarith
  simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_one] using
    (sum_fouvryTau_le j ⌊x⌋₊).trans
      (mul_le_mul (Nat.floor_le (by linarith)) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hlog j)

theorem exists_max_image (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) (h : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, ∀ x' ∈ s, f x' ≤ f x := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := max_of_nonempty (h.image f)
  rcases mem_image.mp (mem_of_max hy) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun x' hx' => le_max_of_eq (mem_image_of_mem f hx') hy⟩

theorem prod_le_pow_card [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → N) (n : N) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) :
    s.prod f ≤ n ^ #s := by
  refine (Multiset.prod_le_pow_card (s.val.map f) n ?_).trans ?_
  · simpa using h
  · simp

theorem card_biUnion_le [DecidableEq M] {s : Finset ι} {t : ι → Finset M} :
    #(s.biUnion t) ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, #(t a) :=
  haveI := Classical.decEq ι
  Finset.induction_on s (by simp) fun a s has ih =>
    calc
      #((insert a s).biUnion t) ≤ #(t a) + #(s.biUnion t) := by
        rw [biUnion_insert]; exact card_union_le ..
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ insert a s, #(t a) := by grind

theorem card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise [DecidableEq M] {f : ι → M} {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset M}
    (H : (s : Set ι).MapsTo f t) : #s = ∑ b ∈ t, #{a ∈ s | f a = b} := by
  simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to H]

theorem card_image_of_injOn [DecidableEq β] (H : Set.InjOn f s) : #(s.image f) = #s := by
  simp only [card, image_val_of_injOn H, card_map]

theorem deletedProduct_mul (a : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) :
    deletedProduct a i * a i = ∏ j, a j := by

theorem deletedProduct_dvd {a : ι → ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hprod : (∏ j, a j) = n) (i : ι) : deletedProduct a i ∣ n := by

E1_span.literal_source:
1. An elementary short-interval divisor bound

For integer k>=2, let d_k(n) be the number of ordered k-tuples of positive
integers with product n. If I is an interval in [1,Z], Z>=2, of length Y,
then

 sum_(n in I) d_k(n)
 <= k*[Y*(1+log Z)^(k-1)+Z^(1-1/k)*(1+log Z)^(k-2)].       (E1)

Proof. For every ordered tuple choose a largest coordinate (use the first
one in a tie). If its value is v and the product of the other coordinates
is d, then v>=n^(1/k), so d<=n^(1-1/k)<=D=Z^(1-1/k).
There are at most k choices of its position. For each ordered remaining
tuple of product d, the condition dv in I permits at most Y/d+1 integers
v. Dropping the requirement that v be largest only increases the count.
Therefore the left side is at most

 k*sum_(d<=D) d_(k-1)(d)*(Y/d+1).

The elementary product expansions give, for j>=1,

 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d)/d <= (1+log D)^j,
 sum_(d<=D) d_j(d) <= D*(1+log D)^(j-1).

For the second inequality, sum the last factor with floor(D/product)
and then use the first inequality for the other j-1 factors; j=1 is
immediate. Substitution proves (E1). All endpoints and locations of I
are allowed; no coprimality condition or arithmetic progression is used.
